item.title: Editorial: Controversial measures often used as extortion in omnibus legislation
item.description: U.S. Rep. Vicente Gonzalez last week cast a vote that might cost him his seat in Congress. Gonzalez, whose district includes Cameron, Willacy and part of eastern Hidalgo County, joined six other Democrats, including Laredo’s Henry Cuellar whose district runs from Starr County to Laredo, in voting for a federal funding bill that includes more money for Immigration and Customs and Enforcement and other Homeland Security departments.
